technical_requirements: POC ingest scope: 2M historical tickets + 80k Confluence pages + product PDFs (~1.2TB raw).
Retrieval: dense embeddings + hybrid BM25 fallback. Must support metadata filters (product, version, region, updated_at).
Freshness: incremental embeddings for new/updated docs within 30 min; TTL/re-embed policy for high-change docs.
Citations: response must include up to 3 source citations with URL/path + excerpt offsets; audit logs for outputs.
Tooling: tool-calling to create/update tickets (Zendesk API), escalate to L2 with context payload, redact PII before ticket writes.
SLOs: 95th percentile end-to-end latency (retrieval + generation) <= 300ms for agent assist flows; throughputs up to 120 req/s sustained; burst to 400 req/s for 30m windows.
Reliability: automatic fallback to cached canonical answers + lower-cost quantized model when GPU pool is saturated; multi-region routing for failover.
po_summary: - Precision of citations >= 92% on sampled eval set (200 queries).
- Mean time to refresh answers after a doc update <= 30 minutes.
- Agent satisfaction lift: +8 pts in small pilot (20 agents).
- Cost estimate for target scale ~ $6k-$12k/month depending on batching/quantization choices (show detailed estimate in drive doc).
